description: The thin one-handoff walking-skeleton proof — the milestone's decidable kill-switch gate. One already-scoped contract, one disposable git repository, one installed confirmation-fixture composition, and the full checkpoint path plan -> implement -> validate -> review -> admit -> record -> merge-ready, exercised twice: LIVE against real Claude Code host tasks launched by the qualification harness (never by the product), and IN-PROCESS by the disposable-repository scenario sensor driving the same facade, binding, journal, and evidence loop with the planted failures the milestone names. Every claim below states which leg proved it; nothing is claimed beyond what ran.

criteria.statement: an already-scoped contract accepted inside a host task reaches merge-ready without operator stage choreography
criteria.evidence: two headless host tasks drove every checkpoint themselves; the only human inputs across the whole delivery were the two policy-required confirmations

criteria.statement: ending the task after an intermediate checkpoint and resuming in a fresh task replays no accepted work
criteria.evidence: the first task ended cleanly after the validating -> reviewing checkpoint; SessionEnd recorded honest Tier 2 paused; the fresh task resumed at reviewing with plan and implement stage results durable exactly once

criteria.statement: resume at the graded floor is one operator-authorized takeover through the facade channel into a fresh worktree from the last trusted commit, not counted as an intervention
criteria.evidence: one takeover authorization consumed on the binding-owned fixture channel; fresh worktree on takeover-2 at the last trusted commit; fence 2 superseded fence 1; interruption counter 2, intervention counter 0

criteria.statement: a green-but-unrelated change fails criterion mapping, and horizontal expansion stops if any of this fails
criteria.evidence: the criterion maps only to a passing exact-candidate trusted-sensor result; a failed, stale-candidate, or absent result leaves the criterion blocked and merge-ready refuses

hosts.admission: session-scoped --settings composed by the binding (grant-derived permission allow rules, model-external PreToolUse interceptor, SessionEnd lifecycle hook) with --setting-sources set to the empty selection, so candidate-writable scopes are excluded and the binding's digest-bound settings file is the session's only settings source

delivery.externalVerification: delivery-harness verify: verified; attestation label 'self / workspace-scoped — process discipline and freshness, not provenance'

interruptionBreakdown: contract confirmation at the already-scoped handoff

live.statement: real Claude Code v2.1.97 host tasks, launched headlessly by the qualification harness driver (never by the product), drove the delivery through the facade's managed CLI surface

phases.ran: plan -> implement -> native git commit -> candidate checkpoint -> trusted sensor -> reviewing, unattended
clean host end after an intermediate checkpoint; the model-external SessionEnd hook appended activity.observed paused (Tier 2 trusted lifecycle evidence); the delivery checkpoint did not move

status reported paused + takeover-required; one operator confirmation consumed on the facade channel; prior workspace quarantined; fresh host-created worktree bound at the last trusted commit under fence 2

two mandatory lenses as two distinct native subagents with independently constructed contexts, review reduction, compounding, admission through the existing harness evidence boundary, neutral tracked-record commit, external verification, merge-ready completion — unattended

notExercisedLive: planted implementation/sensor/reviewer failures (the live sessions took the green path; the fixture leg plants all three)
the production interactive confirmation channel (the composition ran the plan's confirmation-fixture profile, which the installer production-rejects)
same-worktree resume (out of reach by design below Tier 3)

fixture.statement: the disposable-repository scenario sensor drives the same facade, admission binding, append-only journal, and existing evidence loop in-process, with the planted failures the milestone names

scenarios.statement: one active host task progresses without operator stage choreography
the trusted sensor catches a planted defect and validation loops through remediation
the candidate rewrites its tracked sensor to always pass, and the trusted-base copy still governs
a planted review finding loops through remediation and a fresh aligned review
same-context lens relabeling cannot synthesize reviewer independence; every counted reviewer requires a distinct host invocation receipt
termination leaves the delivery paused (Tier 2) safely and a fresh task resumes from the last trustworthy checkpoint with no replayed work
model-minted contract and takeover confirmations are refused (model-visible surface, orphaned channel)
a tampered receipted projection byte fails closed at the next canonical recheck with a typed blocker
one typed blocker is readable through the facade without inspecting internal module commands
the operator-intervention counter stays zero while the host can proceed, moves on a journaled operator-input blocker, and counts the policy-required confirmations separately
the product's complete process inventory across the delivery is git and node (the trusted-base sensor); no agent runtime, no worktree lifecycle operation, no daemon

moduleBoundaries: the V-slices live in the final module boundaries (policy, checkpoint, workflow, host, evidence, finish-line, facade) and are enforced by the import-boundary sensor's protected-class registry with per-module dependency allowlists
